replies.body:
Added a VCR test for this branch in cfaa251.
While debugging, I noticed that setting model.stop_sequences directly doesn't make it into invocation_params. Using model.bind(stop_sequences=[...]) does, though, which is what this path expects. I verified that with a few local debug prints (removed before committing).
The test now goes through the bind() path and checks that the span includes the expected stop_sequences attribute.

Applied this in 9453b28 — added a third fallback checking serialized["kwargs"]["stop_sequences"] for the constructor-time case. Added a new VCR test (test_chat_anthropic_claude_sonnet_stop_sequences_constructor_fallback) covering it, verified against both the latest and oldest supported langchain-anthropic versions. All checks green.
